title: Require reviewed published allocation before BADF project intake
owner: Vily / Mr. Ounekhamvilay PHIMMASONE (@pvily), human session operator and accountable work owner
objective: Refuse conflicting or unverified intake allocations before target mutation; consume an explicit published and independently reconciled WP claim.
business_value: Prevent ID collisions, target overwrite and invalid admission records while retaining existing human authority and offline evidence controls.
in_scope: Explicit intake allocation CLI and bound evidence contract
Offline sweep validation and independent reconciliation
Shared Git common-directory reservation, target/registry coordination and conservative recovery
out_of_scope: Global allocator service or new network dependencies
Placeholder ledger, monkeypatch or unrelated PR merge
acceptance_criteria: No landed-only fallback; explicit allocation consistent across all outputs
All malformed, conflicting, incomplete or stale inputs refuse before target writes
Same-ID/sibling-worktree and distinct-ID/same-target contenders cannot both succeed
Recovery retains evidence and foreign changes
Existing AGENTS preserved and G00 remains unsigned HUMAN_REQUIRED
Independent candidate review and composed-result verification under required BADF authority
permissions: Authorized: isolated branch edits implementing the exact reviewed allocator plan, contracts, callers, documentation and tests
Authorized: negative-first testing, independent review and acceptance/merge evidence preparation
No merge, release, deploy, runtime, human-role impersonation or gate approval authority
tests: Negative-first allocator/intake evidence, drift, path/sentinel, concurrency and failure-recovery tests
python3 scripts/badf_gate.py repo on composed candidate
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' on composed candidate
evidence: Issue365 frozen body and exact exported demand
Published claim6100610515 and retained sweep inputs/report
Future RED/GREEN, composed candidate checks and required approvals; NOT_RUN at proposal stage

rollback.method: Before landing, abandon isolated candidate while preserving claim/evidence; after landing, reviewed revert under existing controls. Intake recovery must verify ownership/bytes and retain failed receipt/reservation; never recursively remove changed foreign data.
